limitations: Six tasks share each arm context, including full child source and missing-child fragment
24 outcomes are correlated rather than independent trials
Easy AXI tasks reach accuracy ceiling in every arm
Model identity supported by native spawn configuration only
Token usage and total agent latency unavailable
baseline_tools: read supplied RTL and build configuration
mcp_tools: baseline plus dedicated fresh slang-mcp process

scoring.success: answered and exact typed oracle match
scoring.correct_abstention: abstained and controller oracle says insufficient information
scoring.infrastructure_failure: model mismatch, missing tools, timeout, or no final response; retain separately

leakage_control: Only tasks.agent.json task object and copied listed source files may be sent to workload worker. Controller oracle file must remain outside workspace. Prompt-only native restrictions must be labelled soft isolation.
launch_gate: Coordinate with parent before launching. Do not replace requested model or effort. Verify runtime identity before accepting a measured trial.
